seoTitle: Nginx log_format and Apache LogFormat to Regex
metaDescription: Paste an nginx log_format or Apache LogFormat and get a named-group regular expression for JavaScript and Python, tested on a sample line. Free.
intro: Converts a log format directive into a regular expression with named groups and tests it on a sample line.
why:
Custom log formats are the usual reason a standard parser fails. Writing the regex by hand means escaping brackets and quotes for every field.

The tool maps each nginx variable or Apache code to a pattern, using the quotes or brackets around it to choose between a non-space, quoted or bracketed match. The result was tested against Python on sample lines. Odd content such as stray quotes in a user agent can still break a match.
howTo: Paste the log_format or LogFormat line.
Paste one real log line as a sample.
Check that every field is extracted.
Copy the JavaScript or Python regex.

faq.a: The common nginx variables and Apache codes. Unknown ones get a safe non-space pattern.

faq.q: Why does my sample not match?
faq.a: A field may contain spaces or quotes the pattern does not allow. Adjust that group by hand.
